Lena — thanks for the note and for sending the MSA.

Quick answers up front: we support AWS Private Offers + public listing, Azure Marketplace (VM and SaaS offers), and GCP Marketplace listing models. Timeline depends on provider and whether you need a private offer or public listing: 

- AWS: 3–6 weeks (private offer + minimal listing assets)
- Azure: 4–8 weeks (SaaS offers often need additional validation)
- GCP: 3–6 weeks (container/VM vs SaaS varies)

I attached our internal marketplace checklist (spreadsheet) and an example AWS payload we submit to the intake portal. High level asks from each provider:

- Creative: 1 hero image (1200x600), 3 screenshots, short + long descriptions
- Legal/Sec: SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 attestation letter; data handling and retention language; contact for security questionnaire
- Billing: preferred SKU model (BYOL vs metered) and procurement contact for private offers

Action items I suggest:
1) Quick sync this Wed 16 Feb, 10:00–10:30 PT (I can host).
2) CloudBridge to confirm: preferred pricing model + procurement contact.
3) Redwood to start AWS intake payload draft and route to AWS partner manager.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_checklist_v2.xlsx; aws_listing_payload.json; hero-image-1200x600.png

On Wed, let's include Ben from AWS if possible — he can confirm the private offer path.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt

Thanks for looping me in. Quick notes from AWS Partner Ops: 

- We can accelerate a Private Offer if you provide the intake payload and a procurement contact for CloudBridge. Standard review is 5–10 business days after submission.
- Required artifacts: listing descriptions, hero image (1200x600), one security contact and SOC2 attestation (or timeline for delivery).
- Link to the intake portal: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/ListingPortal (use your partner account).

If useful, I can join Wed's sync to confirm fields the intake form will validate. Also: we recommend avoiding metered pricing with >3 dimensions for the initial private offer — it slows approval.

Best,
